name: gmail
description: Read/draft/clear a personal Gmail or Google Workspace mailbox via IMAP using an app password — no OAuth app or browser. List the inbox, show a message, archive mail, and stage reply/new drafts in the Drafts folder. Staging is draft-only; a reviewed draft is sent only on explicit per-message say-so via --send-draft. Also manages Gmail filters programmatically (list/create/append/delete) via a separate, additive OAuth settings-only path.
